no_mutant_rows.W1301-PRELOAD-MATCHES-REGISTERED-CHANNEL: a source comparison between two files, not a branch: the row would need a mutant in the preload text, and mutating a file the check only reads is the same trick as asserting a shape
no_mutant_rows.W1301-WORKBENCH-COVERS-FOUR-CLIENTS: same kind: an HTML inventory, verified by reading the file the renderer loads
no_mutant_rows.W1301-WORKBENCH-TELLS-NOBODY-TO-USE-A-TE: same kind: an absence over prose, which is why the behavioural counterpart W1301-FIRST-RUN-NEEDS-NO-TERMINAL carries the mutant instead
no_mutant_rows.W1301-NATIVE-PICKER-IS-REGISTERED-IN-MAI: an Electron-only path; it is source-level until a desktop session can open the dialog, and the card discloses that step rather than faking it
no_mutant_rows.W1301-FOUR-NATIVE-CLIENTS-ROUTED: the route table is data; H1..H6 kill what the table is used for, and a mutant that renames a key would only restate the assertion
no_mutant_rows.W1301-DRIVER-RAN: the harness liveness row; it fails when the program itself breaks

note: each case rewrote exactly one production line and restored it; anchor-missing and crashed cases count as untested guards, never as kills, and the rows that no mutant can reach are named with their reason rather than left out silently
